title: Add adversarial TUI command fixtures
purpose: Prove the TUI command surface fails closed against shell injection, approval mutation, direct activation and secret leakage attempts.
scope: Add fixtures for shell syntax, pipes, redirects and command substitution.
Add fixtures for approval parameter mutation and stale token reuse.
Add fixtures for install/stage pretending to activate artifacts.
Add fixtures for prompt injection text entered as operator intent.
Add fixtures for secret-like payloads in commands and render output.
acceptance_criteria: Unsafe command fixtures fail before EffectPrepared.
Approval mutation fixtures are rejected with exact token mismatch.
Secret-like fixtures do not appear raw in output or evidence.
failure_modes: Approval mutation is accepted because only run id is checked.
Secret-like input is echoed into audit or TUI output.
